question: How can I install a company's MCP server in my AI client?
ground_truth: To install a company's MCP server in your AI client, you need to add a configuration snippet to your AI client's configuration. The configuration includes a JSON object that specifies the MCP server with the company name, command set to "npx", and args containing "-y" and the package name in the format "<your-company>-mcp-server@latest".
